name: davi-route
description: EXPERIMENTAL routing hooks for measuring a verifier inside Claude Code. Pick route_mode: post (cheap subagent first, a verifier checks its result and asks for a strong re-run when needed), pre (a verifier reads the task before the subagent runs and sends it to the cheap or the strong model directly) both (route up front, then verify what went to the cheap model) or tiers (rate difficulty, pick the cheap, mid or strong model). B: at Stop, a verifier checks completion and can block the stop once. All off by default and fail-open. Install as davi-route@datumo, or load with --plugin-dir from an EVAL.Davi checkout.

route_enabled.title: Subagent routing on/off
route_enabled.description: Turn subagent routing (A + E) on. How it routes is route_mode.

route_mode.title: Routing mode
route_mode.description: post: cheap first, verify the answer, re-run with the strong model if needed | pre: judge the task before it runs, send it to the cheap or the strong model directly | both: pre, then verify what went to the cheap model | tiers: rate the task's difficulty and send it to the cheap, mid or strong model.

route_pre_threshold.title: pre: send to the strong model below P(cheap model succeeds)

route_cheap_model.title: Cheap subagent model
route_cheap_model.description: Model string for the first attempt (e.g. haiku).

route_strong_model.title: Strong subagent model
route_strong_model.description: Model string after an escalation (e.g. opus).

route_mid_model.title: tiers: mid subagent model
route_mid_model.description: Model string for medium-difficulty tasks (e.g. sonnet).

route_tier_low.title: tiers: cheap model below this difficulty
route_tier_low.description: Difficulty 0-1 from the judge. Fitted on KLEAR (hard Korean QA); recalibrate for your tasks.

route_tier_high.title: tiers: strong model from this difficulty
route_tier_high.description: Difficulty 0-1 from the judge. Fitted on KLEAR (hard Korean QA); recalibrate for your tasks.

route_tier_check.title: tiers: verify cheap-model answers
route_tier_check.description: Also verify what went to the cheap model and re-run it with the strong model below route_threshold.

route_pin_cheap.title: Pin the cheap model
route_pin_cheap.description: always | if_unset | off: when to set the cheap model on an Agent call without a pending escalation.

stop_verify_enabled.title: B: completion check at Stop
stop_verify_enabled.description: Verify completion when the agent stops; block once below the threshold.

auto_install_deps.title: Install httpx if missing
auto_install_deps.description: At session start, when routing or the stop check is on and python3 cannot import httpx, pip-install it into the plugin's data folder (needs network). Off: install httpx yourself.

log_file.title: Log file (JSONL)
log_file.description: One line per hook call: probabilities, decisions, models, latency, estimated judge cost. No text.

davi_base_url.title: Davi server URL (davi judge)
davi_base_url.description: http://host:port of a Davi server (POST /v1/systemone). When set, the davi judge calls it instead of the RunPod endpoint. Overrides the DAVI_BASE_URL environment variable.

davi_api_key.title: Davi server key (davi judge, optional)
davi_api_key.description: Bearer key, only if your Davi server requires one.

anthropic_api_key.title: Anthropic API key (claude judge)
anthropic_api_key.description: Used only by the claude judge.
